meta.name: build-ci-migration-assistant
meta.description: Automatically migrates build systems and CI/CD configurations to target platforms. Use when modernizing build infrastructure, switching CI/CD providers, or standardizing across projects. Supports common migration paths including Maven↔Gradle, npm↔Yarn, Travis CI→GitHub Actions, CircleCI→GitHub Actions, Jenkins→GitLab CI, and GitLab CI→GitHub Actions. Analyzes existing configuration, generates equivalent target configuration, maps dependencies and commands, and provides validation and migration documentation.
